entries.message:
{count} problem(s) across the content:
  {list}
the schema declares this collection, but content/ has no such folder.
entries.fix: Create the folder, or remove the collection from the schema.

entries.message: a collection cannot be named {name} — that artifact name belongs to the generated index.
{path} is not a usable schema: {detail}.
the collection is not in the schema — it publishes, but nothing validates it.
the entry has a body, but the collection is data-only (body: false) — it will not render.
entries.fix: Remove the body, or allow one in the collection's schema.

entries.message: {field} references uuid {uuid}, and {collection}/ has no entry carrying it.
entries.fix: Point it at an entry that exists, or create that entry.

entries.message: the entry has no uuid, so nothing can reference it and a rename will orphan its history.
this required field is missing.
entries.fix: Add it to the entry's frontmatter.

entries.message: this field is not in the schema — it publishes, but nothing validates it.
entries.fix: Declare it in content/schema.json, or remove it.

entries.message: {field} names the term {slug}, and {taxonomy}/ has no such entry.
the entry has no title, so listings will show its slug.
entries.fix: Give it a title in its frontmatter.

entries.message: expected {expected}, got {got}.
entries.fix: Change the value in the entry's frontmatter.

entries.message: {where} could not be read: {detail}.
entries.fix: The file's own error is this one's cause; fix the file and build again.

entries.message: {where} has fields that do not match the schema: {problems}.
entries.fix: Fix those fields in the file and build again.

entries.message: {name} is not a collection name — letters, digits, _ and -, starting alphanumeric.
entries.fix: Rename the collection; its folder under content/ takes the same name.

entries.message: {at} must be an object.
expected a collections object.
{at} — not a field name: letters, digits, _ and -, starting alphanumeric.
{at} needs a type from: {types}.
entries.fix: Give the field one of those types.

entries.message: {at} — "{name}" is implicit and cannot be declared.
entries.fix: Remove it: every entry has uuid, title, body and slug already.

entries.message: not valid JSON — {detail}.
{at} — a list holds 'string' or 'number' items.
expected an object.
{at} — a reference needs the collection it points into.
{at} — a select needs a non-empty options array.
{at} — a taxonomy field names its term collection.
{at} points at taxonomy {taxonomy}, which is not a declared collection — terms are entries, so a taxonomy needs its collection.
entries.fix: Declare that collection, or point at one that exists.

entries.message: unknown version {version} — this reader understands 1.
entries.fix: Set "version": 1, or update @verajs/cms to a release that reads this version.
